JOB TITLE 
Temporary Biomechanics Research Engineer 
 
 LOCATION 
Worcester 
 
 DEPARTMENT NAME 
Biomedical Engineering - JM 
 
 DIVISION NAME 
Worcester Polytechnic Institute - WPI 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY 
Assist with various biomechanics data collection, analysis, and dissemination in the Musculoskeletal Biomechanics Laboratory. 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Qualified individuals will hold a Master's degree in biomedical engineering and have a broad background in musculoskeletal biomechanics and specific expertise in: 
 quantitative CT analysis 
 motion capture 
 musculoskeletal modeling 
 finite element modeling 
 cadaveric specimen preparation 
 materials testing 
 
 This is an on-site temporary position up to 40 hours per week. Hourly pay rate is $20 per hour depending on experience.
 
 
 FLSA STATUS 
United States of America (Non-Exempt) 
 
 WPI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability. It seeks individuals from all backgrounds and experiences who will contribute to a culture of creativity, collaboration, inclusion, problem solving, innovation, high performance, and change making. It is committed to maintaining a campus environment free of harassment and discrimination.
